氡气（radon）为什么是室内肺癌的重要诱因却常被忽略？

Why is radon an important indoor lung-cancer cause yet often overlooked?

氡是土壤和岩石中铀衰变产生的无色无味的放射性气体，经地基裂缝渗入居室，长期吸入是仅次于吸烟的肺癌风险；它看不见闻不到，需专门仪器检测，因而常被忽视。
Radon is a colorless, odorless radioactive gas from uranium decay in soil and rock that seeps in through foundation cracks; long-term inhalation is the top lung-cancer risk after smoking. Invisible and odorless, it needs special testing, so it's ignored.

室内氡为什么会成为肺癌的重要诱因？它是怎样进入人体并造成伤害的？

Why is indoor radon a major cause of lung cancer, and how does it enter the body and cause harm?

氡是铀-238衰变链产生的放射性惰性气体，半衰期约3.8天，经地基裂缝与孔隙从土壤渗入室内并在低通风房间累积。其短寿命子体钋-218与钋-214附着于气溶胶，吸入后沉积在支气管壁，α粒子电离辐射直接损伤上皮细胞DNA引发癌变；氡因此被认定为仅次于吸烟的第二大肺癌病因，地坪下减压系统是主要降氡手段。
Radon is a colorless, odorless radioactive noble gas produced in the uranium-238 decay chain, with a half-life of about 3.8 days; it seeps from soil through foundation cracks and gaps and accumulates in poorly ventilated rooms. Its short-lived progeny, polonium-218 and polonium-214, attach to airborne aerosols and deposit on bronchial walls when inhaled, where alpha-particle ionization damages epithelial cell DNA and initiates cancer. Radon is therefore recognized as the second leading cause of lung cancer after smoking, and sub-slab depressurization is the principal mitigation measure.

哪些常见室内绿植对降 VOC 有微弱帮助（别神话）？

Which common houseplants weakly help cut VOCs (without mythologizing)?

吊兰、绿萝、常春藤等在实验中能吸收少量甲醛等挥发性有机物，但单盆作用有限，真正有效的是源头少买劣质板材、勤通风。绿植是加分项，不是净化主力。
Spider plants, pothos and ivy absorb small amounts of VOCs like formaldehyde in tests, but a single pot does little; the real fix is fewer poor boards and good ventilation. Plants are a bonus, not the main cleaner.

空气净化器标“CADR/CCM”是什么意思，怎么挑不交智商税？

What do air-purifier 'CADR/CCM' labels mean, and how to avoid a rip-off?

CADR 是洁净空气输出速率，数值越高净化越快；CCM 是滤网累计可净化量，越高越耐用。挑与房间面积匹配、滤网可换且标注真实的机型，比追“负离子”“除醛率99%”的噱头更靠谱。
CADR is clean-air delivery rate—higher cleans faster; CCM is cumulative filter capacity—higher lasts longer. Match the unit to room size with real, replaceable filters rather than chasing 'ions' or '99%' gimmicks.

室内甲醛主要来自哪些材料，通风和活性炭哪个更治本？

Where does indoor formaldehyde come from, and which is more fundamental—ventilation or activated carbon?

人造板材、胶黏剂、部分布艺是主要来源，且会持续释放数年。通风是把已释放的甲醛排走最有效的方法；活性炭只是吸附一小部分、还会饱和，治标不治本。
Composite boards, glues and some fabrics are the main sources and keep emitting for years. Ventilation is the most effective way to remove released formaldehyde; activated carbon only adsorbs a bit and saturates—symptomatic, not fundamental.

新装修的房子为什么要多通风才敢住？

Why must a newly renovated home be well ventilated before living in it?

新家具和油漆会慢慢放出看不见的气味分子，开窗让新鲜空气把它们带走，人在里面呼吸才更安全、更舒服。
New furniture and paint slowly release invisible odor molecules; opening windows lets fresh air carry them away so breathing inside is safer and more pleasant.
